authorization.basis: The user explicitly approved the exact four-request delta-0.4 compositional utility lock, a ceiling of four first-score T4 docking calls, no retries, replacements or backfill, upload of the isolated launch bundle to Modal, and four parallel one-CPU containers with one request per worker.

payload.scientific_problem: Determine whether the four score-blind delta-0.4 compositional-generator endpoints have docking utility under the bound T4 QuickVina evaluator.
payload.primary_output: A durable per-request docking ledger and deterministic membership-preserving endpoint-utility result over the exact four sealed requests.
payload.central_claim_under_test: The prospectively locked eligible compositional endpoints can have nonzero docking utility despite the baseline and expanded generators selecting identical molecules in the predeclared cells.
payload.experimental_setting: Four score-blind endpoint requests selected before docking from 2,560 frozen candidates across five predeclared T4 cells and four baseline/expanded uniform/learned arms.

evaluator.score_unit: kcal/mol as emitted by the bound QuickVina wrapper

execution.attempt_accounting: A successfully published reservation consumes the request's only authorized first-score attempt. A start, docking failure, container failure or missing score receives no retry.
execution.persistence: Publish reservation, start and terminal result or failure records atomically in a request-ID directory on the compose-v4-artifacts Modal volume and commit after each transition.
execution.reduction: Sort all four request identities by request_id; require one terminal record per reservation or report the exact incomplete census without retry. Preserve all memberships from the sealed request lock.

prohibitions: no request beyond the four exact locked request IDs
no retry, replacement or backfill after reservation
no candidate regeneration, mutation or reranking
no teacher endpoint, teacher transformation, teacher score or comparator outcome access
no optimization continuation, controller selection or live-run mutation
payload.interpretation_limit: This prospective panel can establish endpoint docking utility only under the bound QuickVina evaluator. Because baseline and expanded memberships merge to the same four molecules, it cannot estimate an expanded-versus-baseline effect. It also cannot establish teacher or route recovery, autonomous optimization or superiority to IVG.
